description: Introduction and overview of the T-38 Talon: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The T-38 Talon is a twin-engine supersonic trainer built by Northrop, entering service in 1961. It has trained generations of U.S. fighter pilots and NASA astronauts; over 1,100 were built. The type's economy and performance kept it in service for 60+ years, with replacement by the T-7A underway. Baseline facts: Supersonic trainer; service from 1961; 1,146 built by Northrop; trained fighter pilots and astronauts..
